title: Dual-Slot: From Serial Loops to Parallel Slots in Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2610.25086v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Looped language models increase computational depth by repeatedly applying shared layers, offering a way to improve model quality without adding parameters. However, sequential dependencies between loop iterations increase autoregressive decoding latency. We introduce Dual-Slot, an architecture that reorganizes serial looped computation into parallel latent and prediction slots. Rather than waiting for the current token's latent computation to finish, the prediction slot combines the previous token's deep latent state with the current representation, while the latent slot produces a state for the next decoding step. This shifts the latent dependency across adjacent tokens, replacing two sequential module invocations with a single paired invocation while preserving standard autoregressive generation. translated_title: 双槽机制：语言模型中从串行循环到并行槽位
translated_abstract: 循环语言模型通过重复应用共享层来增加计算深度，提供了一种在不增加参数的情况下提升模型质量的途径。然而，循环迭代之间的顺序依赖会增加自回归解码的延迟。我们提出了Dual-Slot，这是一种将串行循环计算重组为并行的潜在槽位与预测槽位的架构。预测槽位无需等待当前token的潜在计算完成，而是将前一个token的深度潜在状态与当前表示相结合，同时潜在槽位为下一个解码步骤生成状态。这将潜在依赖转移到相邻token之间，用一次成对调用取代两次顺序的模块调用，同时保持标准的自回归生成方式。为了在训练期间保持token级别的并行性，我们使用少量雅可比迭代来在整个序列上细化潜在状态。
tldr: Dual-Slot架构将循环语言模型的串行循环计算重组为并行的潜在槽位与预测槽位，通过把潜在依赖转移到相邻token之间，在保持标准自回归生成与参数量不变的前提下，用一次成对调用替代两次顺序调用，从而显著降低自回归解码延迟。
en_tdlr: Dual-Slot reorganizes serial looped computation in language models into parallel latent and prediction slots, reducing autoregressive decoding latency by shifting latent dependencies across adjacent tokens while preserving standard autoregressive generation and parameter efficiency.
